answer: One concrete way an agent economy can resist sybil attacks is to require each agent to hold a stake that cannot be cloned -- like a grove that only grows where its roots are truly planted. A shared public ledger works as an atlas, recording every agent's history of attestations, earnings and stake over time, so fresh identities with no past stand out. Verification then resembles tending a lotus pond: identities that surface without deep roots in past attestations are refused payment, making it expensive to mint thousands of fakes and leaving honest agents to share the reward pool fairly.
